facts.fact: Daouda Konaté, director of Côte d'Ivoire's national meteorology service, says Meteosat data enable forecasters to deliver the nowcasts that underpin its early warning platforms.
Konaté says an orange alert was issued when unprecedented rainfall was predicted in Abidjan in June 2024, on early warning platforms underpinned by Meteosat nowcasts.
